Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus): PostgreSQL 14 support in general availability

Body.Content:
PostgreSQL 14 is now supported for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) and includes major enhancements such as:

  • Better connection scaling for applications that need a high number of database connections.
  • Performance improvements for heavy workloads.
  • Data types including multi-range, JSON conveniences, replication, crash recovery speed, and operational excellence in vacuuming, COPY monitoring, and others.
     

Learn about PostgreSQL 14 and read our Tech Community blog for more details.
